description: I am a passionate student and space enthusiast participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. My project, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," is an engaging storytelling/game experience inspired by space exploration. My strengths include research, Canva design, PowerPoint presentations, and creative visual design. We aim to combine creativity and research to create something meaningful, interactive, and innovative. 🚀🪐
summary:
Ghosts of Space: Their Missions Ended. Their Discoveries Didn't.

Ghosts of Space is an interactive educational platform that explores the stories of equipment left behind during space exploration. It focuses on machines from the Moon and Mars, including Apollo lunar equipment, Surveyor landers, Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Viking, Phoenix, InSight and Ingenuity. It also features related deep-space missions such as Voyager and Dawn.
The platform allows visitors to explore different destinations, discover individual machines and learn about their mission histories, scientific instruments, discoveries and final status. Through interactive explorer profiles, creative storytelling and a science laboratory, we transform NASA's mission information into an engaging learning experience.
Our project addresses the challenge by bringing attention to space equipment that is often overlooked after its mission ends. It is important because these machines represent remarkable achievements in science and engineering. Their stories preserve the history of exploration, help students understand planetary science and inspire future generations to discover the universe.
